title: Penthouse Magazine March 2007 Pet of the Year Complete w/ Centerfold Rob Corddry
conditionDescription: Covers clean and bright with no visible creases or tears; spine intact. Light edge wear. Complete with centerfold. See photos.
descriptionText:
Penthouse magazine, March 2007 issue, original $8.99 cover price. Complete with centerfold.

Cover features: 2007 Pet of the Year; Hollywood Heat: Glitter Girls Get Dirty; Rob Corddry, Charlie Murphy and Katt Williams; Mountain High: snowboarding's early days; March Madness survival guide; plus breakfast tequila, a street-legal race car and The TV You Never Stop Watching.

Back cover: Evan Williams bourbon ad.

Adult collectible - sold to buyers 18+ only. See photos for condition. Ships in a plain, protective mailer.
